Name: Genie Lamp
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod requires Stardew Valley 1.6+[/size][/b]

With this mod installed, you can specify a "lamp" item by name or [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Migrate_to_Stardew_Valley_1.6#Custom_items]qualified item id[/url] (default [b]Golden Mask[/b]) which, when used, allows you to wish for any single item a certain number of items before the lamp item is consumed (default[b] 3[/b]).

The lamp finds items by display name and displays a list of suggestions as you type. Clicking on a suggestion transfers it to the text box.

The mod only finds the first item with a given display name, so it won't work to spawn items like "Wallpaper" since they all have the same display name.

This should work with modded items as well.

Item quality is always 0, and only 1 of any given item can be spawned.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
